shadows.name: paper-shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: Featured print and hovered collection prints.

components.name: Selected category button
components.description: Selected index tab; pressed state belongs to a filter button.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.375rem;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent;font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);height:2rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:0 1.25rem;border-radius:.7rem .7rem .15rem .15rem;font-size:.875rem;background:var(--primary, #365c45);color:var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff)}.ds-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, #365c45) 80%,transparent)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--ring, #365c45);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #365c45) 50%, transparent)}.ds-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-primary:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-primary{padding-inline:1rem}}

components.name: Outline action
components.description: Default compact outline button, used for progressive loading.
components.css: .ds-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.375rem;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent;font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);height:2rem;padding:0 .625rem;border-radius:.75rem;font-size:.875rem;border-color:var(--border, #d5dccf);background:var(--background, #f5f6f0);color:var(--foreground, #283e32)}.ds-outline:hover{background:var(--muted, #ecefe5)}.ds-outline:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--ring, #365c45);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #365c45) 50%, transparent)}.ds-outline:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-outline:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}

components.name: Ghost suggestion action
components.description: Shuffle action above the featured recipe print.
components.html: <button class="ds-ghost" type="button"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m18 14 4 4-4 4m0-20 4 4-4 4M2 18h2.5a6 6 0 0 0 5-3l5-6a6 6 0 0 1 5-3H22M2 6h2.5a6 6 0 0 1 5 3l5 6a6 6 0 0 0 5 3H22"/></svg>Another idea</button>
components.css: .ds-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.375rem;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent;font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);height:2rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:0 .75rem;border-radius:.75rem;font-size:.8rem;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground, #283e32)}.ds-ghost:hover{background:var(--muted, #ecefe5)}.ds-ghost:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--ring, #365c45);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #365c45) 50%, transparent)}.ds-ghost:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-ghost:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}

components.name: Unselected category tab
components.description: Leaf-paper filter button with apricot hover.
components.css: .ds-tab{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.375rem;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent;font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);height:2rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:0 1.25rem;border-radius:.7rem .7rem .15rem .15rem;font-size:.875rem;background:var(--secondary, #e5eddf);color:var(--secondary-foreground, #36513c)}.ds-tab:hover{background:var(--accent, #f6d4bc);color:var(--accent-foreground, #68442d)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--ring, #365c45);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #365c45) 50%, transparent)}.ds-tab:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-tab:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-tab{padding-inline:1rem}}

components.name: Recipe search
components.description: Visible label, inset SVG search icon, white search field.
components.css: .ds-search{font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);color:var(--foreground, #283e32)}.ds-search label{display:block;margin-bottom:.65rem;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600}.ds-search-wrap{position:relative}.ds-search svg{position:absolute;top:50%;left:1.1rem;width:1.15rem;height:1.15rem;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--primary, #365c45);pointer-events:none}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;height:3.5rem;padding:.25rem 1rem .25rem 2.85rem;font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-size:1rem;border:1px solid var(--input, #b8c6b4);border-radius:.5rem;background:var(--card, #ffffff);color:var(--foreground, #283e32);caret-color:var(--primary, #365c45);outline:none;transition:color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground, #5d6c60)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring, #365c45) 50%,transparent)}.ds-search input:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}

components.name: Native recipe sort
components.description: Labeled native select with paper fill and field-edge stroke.
components.css: .ds-sort{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--foreground, #283e32)}.ds-sort select{min-height:2.75rem;max-width:100%;padding:.5rem .75rem;border:1px solid var(--input, #b8c6b4);border-radius:.5rem;background:var(--background, #f5f6f0);color:var(--foreground, #283e32);font:inherit}.ds-sort select:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #365c45); outline-offset: 5px;}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-sort{flex-direction:column;align-items:start;gap:.25rem}}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-sort{flex-direction:row;align-items:center}}.ds-sort label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

components.name: Cookbook header
components.description: Warm serif wordmark and collection anchor share a fine ruled header.
components.html: FoodbookBrowse the collection
components.css: .ds-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, #d5dccf);color:var(--foreground, #283e32)}.ds-wordmark{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.65rem;font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif);font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.03em;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-wordmark svg{flex-shrink:0;color:var(--primary, #365c45)}.ds-nav-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav-link:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2em}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #365c45); outline-offset: 5px;}.ds-wordmark:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, #365c45);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-header{gap:1rem;padding-bottom:1rem}.ds-wordmark{font-size:1.45rem}.ds-nav-link{max-width:8rem;font-size:.75rem;line-height:1.4}}

components.name: Recipe photo print
components.description: Collection link with a real unchanged starter photo; category text is factual metadata.
components.css: .ds-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;padding:.6rem;border-radius:.2rem;background:var(--card, #ffffff);color:var(--foreground, #283e32);text-decoration:none;box-shadow:var(--paper-shadow,0 6px 18px rgb(40 62 50 / 8%));transition:transform 250ms var(--ease-paper,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),box-shadow 250ms var(--ease-paper,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--paper-shadow-raised,0 12px 26px rgb(40 62 50 / 13%))}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #365c45); outline-offset: 5px;}.ds-card img{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}.ds-card-caption{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem;padding:1rem .5rem .5rem;font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);}.ds-category{margin:0;color:var(--primary, #365c45);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500}.ds-title-row{display:flex;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem}.ds-title-row h3{margin:0;font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif);font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:550;line-height:1.25;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-title-row svg{flex-shrink:0;margin-top:.35rem;color:var(--primary, #365c45)}.ds-facts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem 1rem;margin:.25rem 0 0;color:var(--muted-foreground, #5d6c60);font-size:.75rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card{transition:none}.ds-card:hover{transform:none}}

components.name: Featured inspiration print
components.description: Featured photo print with a stable three-line title area; live suggestions select another recipe randomly without immediate repeats or image animation. Before the first random pick, visibility is hidden with layout space retained; no-JavaScript users see the static fallback.
components.css: .ds-feature{min-width:0;padding:.25rem .6rem .75rem}.ds-note{margin:0 0 1rem;font-family:var(--font-handwritten,Kalam,cursive);font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--primary, #365c45)}.ds-print{display:block;padding:.85rem;border-radius:.2rem;background:var(--card, #ffffff);color:var(--foreground, #283e32);text-decoration:none;box-shadow:var(--paper-shadow-raised,0 12px 26px rgb(40 62 50 / 13%));transform:rotate(2deg);transition:transform 300ms var(--ease-paper,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-paper,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-print:hover{transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(-3px)}.ds-print:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #365c45); outline-offset: 5px;}.ds-print img{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}.ds-print-caption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:1rem .35rem .4rem}.ds-print-caption h2{display:-webkit-box;block-size:3lh;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;margin:.25rem 0 0;font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif);font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2vw,1.7rem);font-weight:550;line-height:1.2;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-print-caption svg{flex-shrink:0;width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;color:var(--primary, #365c45)}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-feature{padding-inline:.25rem}.ds-print{transform:rotate(1deg);padding:.65rem}.ds-print img{aspect-ratio:16/9}.ds-note{margin-bottom:.65rem}.ds-print-caption{padding-top:.75rem}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-print{transition:none}.ds-print,.ds-print:hover{transform:none}}.ds-print-caption>div{flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-print-caption .ds-category{display:block;block-size:1.6em;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-category{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.6;color:var(--primary,#365c45)}.ds-print[data-pending='true']{visibility:hidden}

narrative.overview:
A personal collection of recipes feels kept and revisited: pale green-white paper, dark green ink, white photo prints, and occasional handwritten notes. The character is playful but adult, with a calm reading surface and small tactile cues rather than decorative clutter.

Fraunces gives recipe titles warmth; Geist keeps controls clear; Kalam marks a few personal notes. Photograph-led cards stay aligned while the featured print supplies the single tilt. The user's chosen replacement world establishes the current light theme; the previous look is not a visual constraint.
keyCharacteristics: Green ink and leaf tabs on pale paper.
White photo-print frames with quiet diffuse shadows.
Warm serif titles, clear sans-serif controls, occasional handwritten notes.
A single tilted featured print; orderly collection cards.

rules.name: The Note Rule
rules.body: Reserve handwriting for short personal notes; retain Geist for actions and reading support.

rules.name: The Single Tilt Rule
rules.body: Only the featured print tilts: 2deg at larger sizes, 1deg on mobile. Collection cards stay aligned at rest.

dos: Do use the green-paper palette and white photo frames for the current light world.
Do keep recipe photos and their source provenance intact.
Do preserve visible control labels, keyboard focus, wrapping titles, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do reserve handwriting for short personal notes; retain Geist for actions and reading support.
Do keep the featured print as the single tilted element and collection cards aligned at rest.
donts: Don't turn recipe category metadata into a decorative kicker system.
Don't spread rotations or hard offset shadows across the collection.
Don't promote this homepage's search-and-suggestion composition into a compulsory layout for every surface.
Don't treat source review as desktop/mobile visual sign-off.
